senses.gloss: aurabhrika, m. (= Pali orabbhika; not in this mg. in Skt.; from urabhra plus -ika), mutton-butcher (sometimes perhaps butcher in general): Mvy 〔3758〕 = Tib. (b)śan pa, butcher: SP 〔280.2〕; 〔480.9〕; Laṅk 〔246.7〕; 〔253.5〕 (here text ˚bhraka but v.l. ˚bhrika, which prob. read); Divy 〔10.2〕; 〔15.22〕; Bbh 〔302.9〕; Kv 〔42.9〕 (text noratri˚, read naurabhn˚ = na-aur˚); 〔94.22〕.
